Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep procurement moving: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — full PDF preferred.
2) Signed bridge letter or temporary attestation if the Type II is older than 12 months.
3) Trusted upload to our portal (or a secure DocSend link) so our security team can pull artifacts; if you prefer we can issue a portal invite.

I attached a short evidence intake spreadsheet (SMK_evidence_request.xlsx) to map which artifacts we need. If you can share expected timing for the items above, we’ll thread Procurement with a proposed PO timeline.

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa (security) will validate the report and confirm any follow-up artifacts.
- Aditya (sales) will confirm deal timeline and any credit/PO requirements.

If it helps, Marissa can send a step-by-step portal invite and bridge-letter template. Appreciate you looping Lina from InfoSec — if there are any redaction concerns or NDA constraints call them out and we’ll accommodate.

Best,
Irene

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) on the call. I’m the security lead on this review. A few operational items and attachments to move this along: 

Operational steps (recommended):
- Option A (fast): Upload the SOC 2 Type II PDF and signed bridge letter to our Trust Portal link. I’ll validate and open any artifact requests in the portal.
- Option B: If you prefer not to use the portal, share a secure DocSend link with view/download disabled after review.

Required artifacts we've seen typically include:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter or interim attestation (scoped to controls relevant to your integration)
- Description of data processing (if PHI/PII involved — note HIPAA/GDPR considerations)

I’ve attached the Redwood bridge letter template (redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf) and a short portal guide (portal_invite_instructions.txt) that outlines retention (90 days by default for intake) and access controls (RBAC + audit log). We can extend retention upon request; state that in the portal comment.

Regarding temporary attestation: yes, we can accept a one-page interim attestation to unblock procurement. Please note we will need the full report or scoped attestations before final approval.

Next actions for SmokeyTech:
1) Upload SOC 2 Type II (preferred) OR provide DocSend link.
2) Upload signed bridge letter (or use our template).
3) Add a note in the portal if you need longer retention or KMS/HSM details.

If you upload to the portal, send me the upload confirmation and I’ll kick off the validation.

Thanks — I’ll watch for the files.
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
